Container.Name: AussieTV
Container.Overview: Experimental Australian free-to-air TV guide and player, with an optional keyed Jellyfin M3U/XMLTV feed. Configure an HTTPS reverse proxy on a trusted private network and an exact browser origin before use. Do not expose these ports to the Internet. No bundled broadcaster subscriptions or DRM bypass.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent guide cache. Directory must be writable by UID/GID 10001.

Config.Name: TV Web Port
Config.Description: Private-network HTTP backend for your HTTPS proxy. Do not port-forward.

Config.Name: Browser Origin
Config.Description: Required exact HTTPS origin, e.g. https://tv.example.test (no trailing slash). Set the WebUI link in Advanced View to this same URL.

Config.Name: TV Password
Config.Description: Generate a unique random secret, at least 24 characters. Do not reuse your Unraid password.

Config.Name: TV Listener
Config.Description: Container listener; keep the fixed port.

Config.Name: Server Mode
Config.Description: Headless server, no desktop browser launch.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Listener
Config.Description: Optional: set 0.0.0.0:45782 and fill in the base URL and key to enable the feed.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Feed Port
Config.Description: Optional: map to 45782 when enabling Jellyfin. Restrict to trusted clients.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Base URL
Config.Description: URL reachable by Jellyfin, no trailing path or query.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Key
Config.Description: Separate random secret of at least 24 characters.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Region
Config.Description: Region used by Jellyfin M3U and XMLTV.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Transport
Config.Description: redirect recommended; relay and mpegts are experimental.
